description:
Get into the action with a fat tire bike that's built for durable all-terrain riding. Super-sized knobby tires like these create a wider contact patch with the ground, providing you with increased traction on tough trails. Increased traction yields more control, which means hugging turns tighter and owning tricky trail sections. And those things mean more unadulterated riding fun. Conquer the snowy or sandy trails on the Juneau fat bike.
Aluminum bike frame with supersized 26" x 4" all terrain knobby tires.
21-speed Shimano trigger shifter with Shimano rear derailleur.
26" alloy super wide rims with front and rear disc brakes.
Alloy triple crank and threadless headset.
